description: Backend for character sheet management: models, API endpoints, computed stats with equipment modifiers, XP-based leveling

userStories.title: Character model and database table
userStories.description: Create the Character SQLModel with base ability scores, XP, HP, AC, speed, and computed properties for level, proficiency bonus, and ability modifiers. Add migration/table creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Character model exists in backend/app/models/character.py with all fields from PRD
CharacterBase, Character (table=True), CharacterCreate, CharacterRead, CharacterUpdate schemas exist
Level is computed from XP using 5e thresholds (0=L1, 300=L2, 900=L3, etc up to 355000=L20)
Proficiency bonus is computed from level (L1-4=+2, L5-8=+3, L9-12=+4, L13-16=+5, L17-20=+6)
CharacterRead includes computed fields: level, proficiency_bonus, xp_to_next_level, and ability modifiers
Table is created on startup (add to database.py create_all)
userStories.notes: See tasks/prd-character-sheets.md for full XP threshold table. Ability scores default to 10, XP defaults to 0.

userStories.title: CharacterItem model
userStories.description: Create CharacterItem model that mirrors the existing Item model but belongs to a character instead of an inventory. Adds is_equipped boolean field.
acceptanceCriteria: Has same fields as Item (name, type, category, rarity, description, quantity, weight, estimated_value, notes, thumbnail_url, is_standard_item, standard_item_id, properties) plus character_id FK and is_equipped bool
CharacterItemBase, CharacterItem (table=True), CharacterItemCreate, CharacterItemRead, CharacterItemUpdate schemas exist
userStories.notes: The character_id FK references the characters table.

userStories.title: Character CRUD API endpoints
userStories.description: Create router with CRUD endpoints for characters within a party inventory. Uses same X-Passphrase auth as inventory endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/inventories/{slug}/characters/{id} returns character with computed stats
DELETE /api/inventories/{slug}/characters/{id} deletes character and its items
All endpoints require valid X-Passphrase header
userStories.notes: Follow the same auth pattern as the existing inventory/items routers. Use the auth dependency from core/auth.py.

userStories.title: Character items API endpoints
userStories.description: Create endpoints for managing a character's personal inventory items, including equip/unequip.
acceptanceCriteria: All endpoints require valid X-Passphrase header
userStories.notes: Equip/unequip are simple toggles on is_equipped. No slot validation needed.

userStories.title: Computed stats with equipment modifiers
userStories.description: When returning a character via GET, compute effective stats by applying stat_modifiers from all equipped items.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/inventories/{slug}/characters/{id} returns effective_strength, effective_dexterity, effective_constitution, effective_intelligence, effective_wisdom, effective_charisma, effective_ac
Effective stat = base stat + sum of stat_modifiers from equipped items
Equipment modifiers come from item properties.stat_modifiers dict (e.g. {"strength": 2, "ac": 5})
Items with no stat_modifiers or unequipped items don't affect stats
Ability modifiers are computed from effective scores, not base scores
userStories.notes: The CharacterRead schema should include both base and effective stats. Modifiers use floor((effective_score - 10) / 2).

userStories.title: Character API tests
userStories.description: Write tests for all character and character item endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover: create character, get character, list characters, update character, delete character
Tests cover: add item to character, list character items, update character item, delete character item
Tests cover: equip item, unequip item, computed stats with equipment modifiers
Tests cover: XP to level computation (test boundaries like 0, 300, 899, 900, 355000)
Tests verify auth is required (401 without passphrase)
All tests pass with uv run pytest tests/ -v
userStories.notes: Follow the same test patterns as test_items.py and test_inventories.py. Use the existing conftest.py fixtures.
